description: KYET MKP20685J2G362230 metallized polypropylene film capacitor, 6.8 uF +/-5%, 400 VDC, radial through-hole. Manufacturer data gives a 36 x 30 mm body and 1.0 mm lead wire; the exact LCSC/EasyEDA model specifies 48.0 mm lead pitch and 1.2 mm finished holes.
name: kyet-mkp20685j2g362230
watch_out_for: Non-polarized two-terminal film capacitor. The physical body is 36 x 30 mm and the exact LCSC model calls for 48.0 mm pitch; retain that large radial envelope. Directly parallel this 6.8 uF part with the reviewed 1.0 uF Vishay MKP1848510924K2 for 7.8 uF in the 8 ohm / 2.5 kHz high-pass branch (2.55 kHz nominal). C521054 had original-catalog stock 270 and retail stock 300, minimum buy 1, at source check; inventory is time-sensitive.
